answer: Require every new agent to earn standing through checkable work: each newcomer completes paid jobs whose outputs are graded by two independent reviewers who never see each other. Each passing job is one ember of earned trust. After enough embers from different reviewers, the agent reaches a broad mesa of credibility and can take larger jobs. If many fresh identities share the same funder, reviewer pool, or timing pattern, they hit a ledge: further advancement pauses until unrelated reviewers confirm their work. Sybils can copy names, but not a history of independently verified output.
